Chalo, main batati hoon. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao

1/3 ka neeche wala number 3 batata hai ki ek poore ko 3 barabar gaps mein kaatna hai. Ab socho, board par woh ek poora kahan se kahan tak hai. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki line 3 gaps mein kati hai, toh 1/3 yahin hai. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab line ke upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab line ke neeche dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, ek-doosre se ek jitni door. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

Line ke neeche marks ke beech ki khaali jagah gino, aur 0 ke baad wali aur 1 se pehle wali jagah bhi mat chhodna. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: 8 barabar gaps

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se theek ek gap door. Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Doori ke liye khambe ginoge, ya khambon ke beech ke gaps?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Is patti ko raasta samjho: baayan kinaara ghar, daayan kinaara school, aur beech ke teen marks teen khambe. Doori ke liye khambe ginoge, ya khambon ke beech ke gaps?
mujhe nahi pata
Ghar se pehle khambe tak chalo: tum ek gap chale, khamba toh bas wahan khada hai. Doori ke liye khambe ginoge, ya khambon ke beech ke gaps?
haan

Doori gaps se naapte hain: khambe nahi, gaps, kyunki khambe jagahein hain, chalna gaps mein hota hai. Khambe raaste ko kaatte hain: 3 khambon se 4 barabar gaps, kyunki pehle khambe se pehle aur aakhri ke baad bhi ek-ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

Poora raasta 1 kilometre ka hai, aur woh 4 barabar gaps mein kata hai. Ek gap 1 kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, bas yahi socho. 1 kilometre ka raasta 4 barabar gaps mein hai; pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

aapko virat pasand hai?

batting

Haan, bilkul theek: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne. Yahan tak theek hai?

Ab upar wala number batayega ki 0 se kitne gap chalne hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?

Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Line ke neeche 8 barabar gaps hain. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain. 1/5 wale gaps dekho. 0 se theek 1 tak pahunchne ke liye aise kitne gap chalne honge?

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 1/5 ke 5 gap milkar 5/5 banate hain, aur 5/5 = 1. Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Theek beech ka mark 3/6 hai, aur 3, 6 ka aadha hai, toh 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 beech se pehle aata hai, 5/6 beech ke baad. Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.card: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Roti ke 6 barabar hisse socho: 3 hisse le lo toh theek aadhi roti hai, isliye 3/6 = 1/2 beech mein hai. 2 hisse aadhi se kam hain, toh 2/6 beech se pehle, aur 5 hisse aadhi se zyada, toh 5/6 beech ke baad. Is line par 4/6 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: baad mein

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech 3/6 par hai, aur upar wala number 4 usse ek zyada hai, toh ek gap aage, beech ke baad. Chalo, ab ek sawaal saath mein line par karte hain. Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai. 2/5 ka kaunsa number batata hai ki line kitne barabar gaps mein kategi?

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
